control_site_scope: Native and C716 each contain three physical get_id call sites in the planar-die helper; source/native branch review establishes their conditional order. Native Hot Fix stores payload at 025c8460 then kind at 025c8466; current stores payload at 025c854b then kind at 025c8551. Cached decompiler output has those stores reversed. These selected observations do not establish complete CFG equivalence for either helper.
